title: TikTok Influencer Agency Guide: Top Agencies for Creators and Brands (2026)
summary: Compare the best TikTok agencies for creators and brands in 2026. Learn how to join a TikTok agency for free, what commissions to expect, and how to avoid scams.
body_markdown:
## Top TikTok Influencer Agencies by Category (2026)


There is no single agency that suits every creator or brand. The useful distinction is the work each provider is equipped to manage. Use these categories to build a shortlist, then verify current services, relevant experience, and terms directly with each organization. Brands should assess how a partner will connect creator selection to campaign goals and measurement.


### Top Agencies for Brand Campaigns


For sponsored content, look for a team that can translate a brief into creator criteria, manage outreach, coordinate content approvals, and report against agreed objectives. Ask to review campaign deliverables and the reporting format, not just a creator roster. Confirm who communicates with creators and how the team handles content changes or missed deadlines.


### Top TikTok Shop and Affiliate Agencies


Shop and affiliate support is a distinct specialty. A provider in this category may help with product seeding, affiliate creator recruitment, commission planning, and sales reporting. Match its experience to your product, inventory readiness, and fulfillment capacity. A large creator list alone does not show that a team can manage product logistics or track sales attribution.


### Top TikTok LIVE Creator Networks


Creators considering a network should check whether it is an official TikTok LIVE Creator Network and confirm that status through TikTok’s available verification resources. Ask what training, programming feedback, or operational support members receive, and whether participation limits other opportunities. A tiktok creator agency partner should explain the value of its services in concrete terms rather than promise guaranteed audience growth.


### How to Choose the Right Agency for Your Goals


Choose by capability, not a broad “best” label. Creators should compare representation terms, communication expectations, and the types of deals pursued. Brands should check creator vetting, campaign operations, disclosure review, and reporting.
